title: modelsell/modelsell-cli
summary: modelsell/modelsell-cli 是一个用于自动化配置主流 CLI 工具（如 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 和 OpenClaw）的命令行工具，支持使用任何大型语言模型。该项目通过简化配置流程，提高了开发效率和用户体验。，基于模型推理的架构
description: Used to automate the configuration of mainstream CLI tools—such as Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and OpenClaw—and supports the use of any large language model.
